title: Hardcoded Secrets in C#
description: API keys and connection strings are hardcoded and hard-wired into the binary.

finding.title: Hardcoded Credentials
finding.description: API keys and database passwords are embedded directly in source code.
finding.why_dangerous: Source often reaches more people and systems than the secrets should; the binary leaks the value.
finding.impact: Credential theft, unauthorized service access, account takeover.
finding.fix: Load secrets from an external secrets manager or environment config, and rotate anything already leaked.
learning_example: Anyone with the repo (or decompiled binary) can read the key
A secrets manager keeps the value out of the codebase and lets you rotate it

checklist: Keep secrets out of source and version control
Load secrets from env vars / a secrets manager at runtime
Scan repos and CI for leaked credentials
Encrypt config in transit and at rest
